verdict: Good app, but not top-tier yet
verdict_explanation: Loop 28: data_flow 6.5→8.0 via dag.test.ts — 7 tests enforce cross-package and within-app DAG at npm test time. Convention-only enforcement replaced by machine-detectable checks. 35 suites, 234 tests, all green.

architecture_quality.proof: apps/web/src/hooks/useHeadToHeadHandlers.ts:1-115 — H2H action dep-cluster behind Interface; package DAG enforced by test (loop 28); within-app module DAG enforced; implicit global store. 9-anchor not met.

state_management.proof: packages/state/src/tierSlice.ts:1-343 — one writer per concern across 6 slices; store is implicit global, no process-lifetime pattern; 9-anchor not met

domain_modeling.proof: packages/core/src/models.ts — createItem smart constructor + ItemMedia discriminated union (loop 20); apps/web/src/components/ItemModal.tsx:114-135 — primary add-item path migrated to createItem (loop 21). Residual Accounting Pass: 9-anchor met.
domain_modeling.residual_blocking_10: packages/core/src/models.ts:22-31 — Item.imageUrl/videoUrl/audioUrl/mediaType remain independently optional for backward compat with persisted JSON data
domain_modeling.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Framework-constrained: changing Item interface would break deserialization of existing persisted state; migration is cross-cutting and out of scope. Primary construction path enforced via createItem.

Package-level DAG also enforced by workspace package.json. Ambient Redux global store is the one remaining undocumented ambient dependency; RTK effects typed.

framework_idioms.proof: apps/web/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx:63-64 — selectTiers, selectTierOrder named selectors replace inline state => state.tier.tiers/tierOrder. apps/web/src/pages/ThemesPage.tsx:41 — selectSelectedThemeId replaces inline state => state.theme.selectedThemeId. apps/web/src/pages/ImportExportPage.tsx:104-106 — selectProjectName, selectTotalItemCount replace inline useMemo + tiers var. All named selectors are memoized createSelector in @tiercade/state/selectors.ts. RTK idiomatic per CLAUDE.md.

concurrency.proof: apps/web/src/hooks/useImportHandlers.ts:35-38 — useEffect cleanup; abort previous reader on second call. Two abort tests at Interface. No change this loop.

simplicity.proof: packages/core/test/dag.test.ts — compact Node-only implementation (164 lines, no external deps). apps/web/src/pages/TierBoardPage.tsx:1-443 accepted residual (modal-coupled LOC floor).
simplicity.residual_blocking_10: apps/web/src/pages/TierBoardPage.tsx:1-443 — 443 LOC modal orchestration floor; deletion test fails for any extraction without co-moving modal state
simplicity.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Framework-constrained: React component pattern requires co-location of modal state with handlers that close over it. Extraction adds ceremony without removing coupling. Accepted floor.

test_strategy.proof: All 6 web pages have direct page-level test files (loop 24-26). dag.test.ts adds 7 DAG enforcement tests (loop 28). 35 suites, 234 tests, all green.
test_strategy.residual_blocking_10: AppShell routing thin wrapper — no AppRuntime/root-scene shell analog in React/Vite; E2E surface covers integration; direct AppShell test would be ceremony over a 3-route switch
test_strategy.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: React/Vite stack does not have the Apple AppRuntime/root-scene shell pattern. AppShell is a thin react-router-dom BrowserRouter + 6 routes. E2E suite covers integration paths. Accepted carve-out.

findings.title: data_flow DAG was convention-only — no machine enforcement
findings.why_it_matters: Resolved this loop. Cross-package and within-app DAG were enforced only by developer convention; violations would not be caught at test time.
findings.what_is_wrong: packages/core/src/** could import from @tiercade/state/@tiercade/ui/@tiercade/theme without automated catch. Within-app, hooks/ could import from pages/ without detection.
evidence: packages/core/test/dag.test.ts (new, loop 28) — 7 tests: core no-upstream-deps, state no-ui/theme-deps, ui no-state-dep, theme no-tiercade-deps, utils/hooks/components within-app layer ordering
Violation detection verified via Node script: injecting import type { RootState } from '@tiercade/state' into core source causes test failure with specific file+specifier in output
findings.leverage_impact: Without the test, callers of any package layer cannot trust the dependency contract; the test makes violations machine-detectable at CI time.
findings.locality_impact: DAG violations that spread framework types into packages/core or packages/state would cause broad blast radius; the test catches them immediately.
findings.metric_signal: 7 new DAG assertions; 35 total suites, 234 tests passing.
findings.why_weakens_submission: data_flow 6.5 blocked by convention-only enforcement; test changes this to machine-enforced.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Add packages/core/test/dag.test.ts with import-scanning tests per DAG rules.

backlog.title: state_management 6.5 — document Redux store lifetime; add configureStore factory
backlog.why_it_matters: The Redux store in packages/state/src/store.ts has no comment or factory pattern making its process-lifetime and injection point explicit. The 9-anchor for state_management requires 'runtime, persisted, navigation, presentation state separated by Module, not by convention; every writer explicit and reachable from the owner'. The ambient global store makes injection implicit.

builder_notes.pattern: DAG enforcement via import-scanning tests (no external deps)
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Any monorepo where layer violations are caught only by code review, not by CI
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Walk source with fs.readdirSync, grep from/import specifiers, assert forbidden patterns absent. Put the test in the lowest package with testEnvironment: 'node'.

builder_notes.pattern: Within-app layer ordering: utils → hooks → components → pages
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Components importing hooks is idiomatic React (hooks are more primitive). The forbidden direction is hooks→components, hooks→pages, components→pages.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Hooks must not import components or pages. Components must not import pages. Utils must not import any higher layer.
builder_notes.stack_example: dag.test.ts within-app section enforces this for apps/web/src

builder_notes.pattern: Two enforcement levels for monorepo DAG: workspace package.json + import-scanning test
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: npm workspace only catches circular package deps at install time. It does NOT catch a source-level @tiercade/state import inside packages/core/src/ because the workspace symlink resolves it without error.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Add import-scanning tests at Level 2. Level 1 (workspace) and Level 2 (test) together catch all violation paths.
builder_notes.stack_example: packages/core/test/dag.test.ts runs alongside other unit tests at no extra setup cost

builder_notes.pattern: CardView in S2 uses render-prop pattern (children as factory function)
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: <CardView items={...}>{(item) => ...}</CardView> — children is a callback receiving each item

narrative: Good app, place but not win. Loop 28: data_flow 6.5→8.0 via dag.test.ts — 7 tests enforce cross-package and within-app layer DAG at npm test time. Convention-only enforcement replaced by machine-detectable checks. 35 suites, 234 tests, all green. Remaining hard blockers: implicit global Redux store (state_management 6.5), architecture_quality 7.5 (follows from structural gaps). avg ~8.44 (up from 8.33 at loop 27).

loop_result.what_changed: Added packages/core/test/dag.test.ts — 7 DAG enforcement tests. Cross-package rules: packages/core/src no @tiercade/{state,ui,theme} imports; packages/state/src no @tiercade/{ui,theme} imports; packages/ui/src no @tiercade/state import; packages/theme no @tiercade/* imports. Within-app rules: utils/ no higher layers; hooks/ no components/pages imports; components/ no pages imports. Violation detection verified.
loop_result.evidence_change_is_honest: 35 suites, 234 tests all green. dag.test.ts passes with current source (7/7 assertions). Violation detection verified via Node script: injecting forbidden import string causes immediate test failure with specific file+specifier.

implementation_review.reason: All three checks passed: dag.test.ts enforces the cross-package and within-app DAG at test time (7 assertions); deletion test confirms the test earns its keep; no new Seam, no costume layer, no regression introduced — diff is test-only with no production code changes.
